verdict.rationale: Documentation access for agents is a fair question for any product with developer docs, including a chip platform with Metal and ML documentation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs: the probe returned HTTP 404 at developer.apple.com/llms.txt, and the other items cover hardware performance and ML frameworks only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
